title: Package and actually rebuild an owned restricted-rule OCI capability
problem: System9 has no executable OCI packaging despite the available disposable Docker host. Package an existing owned capability and prove immutable image rebuild and second-environment execution.
baseline: Linked FM-LANDLOCK-20261001; PR147 closure head492e6906 CI pending. Existing system2 DSL and system53 fixed-timestamp source packaging; current system9 is PARTIAL.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Use official Python and BuildKit resolved immutable digests, fixed timestamps and exact existing DSL bytes. Build twice on disposable CI and compare OCI content/config/layer digests.
advantages: No new evaluator or authority owner.
disadvantages: Requires actual Docker/registry availability and independently checked output.
alternatives.revival_evidence: New image/runtime/dependency evidence; wider machine obligations remain active.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Package the full GREG and all organ dependencies with gVisor-class execution.
advantages: Advances broad machine portability and general source execution.
disadvantages: Needs larger dependency closure, stronger runner and actual escape/revocation evidence; cannot be claimed from this capability image.
alternatives.revival_evidence: New image/runtime/dependency evidence; wider machine obligations remain active.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Actual signed fixture Body packages context, CI independently builds twice and executes restricted valid/refused requests.
advantages: Closes image evidence with no public activation or image push.
disadvantages: Fixture founder key and restricted capability are not full machine or live founder acceptance.
alternatives.revival_evidence: New image/runtime/dependency evidence; wider machine obligations remain active.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Leave a buildable portability dependency as architecture prose.
disadvantages: Repeats local-proof stopping and leaves system9 unfinished.

roles.position: Package actual owned capability; successful proof immediately resumes full Body + Organs + Mind. These are distinct analytical perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: A context registry can masquerade as OCI execution.

roles.position: Reuse system2 evaluator and system53 epoch; only immutable official base is accepted. GREG worker never receives Docker socket. These are distinct analytical perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: New container package might create a second runtime/authority owner.

roles.position: Refuse mutable/foreign/injected bases and arbitrary source; rootless non-network container with read-only filesystem, no capabilities, CPU/memory/PID ceilings. These are distinct analytical perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: Ordinary Docker cannot establish system10 gVisor-class containment.

roles.position: Retain actual OCI archives, source/base/builder/tool versions, paired digests and host/container cases. Clean builder in finally. These are distinct analytical perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: Timestamp/tool drift may make nominal rebuilds differ.

roles.position: Use fixture founder key and local CI image only, no push or public action. Partial wider packaging and isolation remain explicit. These are distinct analytical perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: A single capability image might be represented as full-machine completion.

evidence.finding: Docker28.0.4 observed; that run failed one confined MCP dependency test and proves no OCI capability.
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH normalizes build timestamps; actual paired output comparison remains mandatory.

counterevidence.finding: Not yet: fresh hosted build/export/run evidence required. Local host has no Docker CLI.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack nominal build claims, mutable input resolution, arbitrary code, false authority, timestamps and Docker-as-microVM claims.

new_weaknesses.statement: A pinned base alone leaves the builder mutable.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Resolve official BuildKit to an immutable digest before creating builder; retain actual Docker/Buildx/BuildKit identities.

new_weaknesses.statement: Context hashes and export success could hide substitution or unequal rebuilt code.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Verify actual OCI blob addresses/descriptors, paired manifest/config/layer identity, loaded config match and six exact host/container results including three refusals.

new_weaknesses.statement: Signed fixture mission might be labelled Alfonso acceptance or whole Body image.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Record exact fixture tier and restricted capability scope; keep system9 partial beyond this proof and continue machine objective.

Retain wider OCI and isolation obligations on completion horizon.

kill_criteria: Untrusted source or worker obtains Docker socket.
Unequal OCI rebuilds or host/container results labelled reproduced.
Image push, public activation or authority manufactured.
Successful image treated as full machine completion.
